claims.head: Don’t buy Hofer’s record against the Ducks
claims.body: Since 2023-24, Hofer has been a wall against the Ducks, well above his usual. Fans love a pattern like this, but we checked three seasons of them and they predicted nothing. Don’t be surprised if the Ducks finally get to him.

story.head: McTavish meets his old team
paras: The Blues have won two in a row, while the Ducks (10-8-1) lost 4-2 to Nashville on Wednesday. Going in, the Ducks are third in the Pacific (tied for 16th in the NHL) and the Blues seventh in the Central (tied for 18th).
The Ducks’ record (.553) is running ahead of what their chances are worth (.496), largely thanks to their finishing. The Blues’ record (.526) is about what their chances are worth.

The Ducks forecheck as hard as almost anyone (2nd) and hit a lot (2nd). They also give up a lot of dangerous shots (31st), so the Blues keep dangerous shots away, but them give up a lot of them. Anaheim has allowed 3.68 goals a game, the third most in the league. On the other side, the Blues keep things calm after the whistle (lowest) and rarely get pinned in their own end (3rd). They also have struggled on the power play (31st), so their struggling power play gets a tough test from the Ducks’ penalty killers.

Leo Carlsson (6 G / 20 A / 26 P in 19 GP) leads the Ducks in scoring. Cutter Gauthier (16 G / 7 A / 23 P in 18 GP) has a team-high 16 goals, tied for third in the NHL, with eleven points in his last five games. Jimmy Snuggerud (10 G / 4 A / 14 P in 19 GP) is tied for the Blues’ scoring lead. Robert Thomas (3 G / 11 A / 14 P in 19 GP) shares it, with six goals in nine games against Anaheim since 2023-24.

Laurent Brossoit (4-1-0 / .866 SV% in 5 GS) has struggled for Anaheim so far, but will likely start. Joel Hofer (8-5-1 / .926 SV% in 14 GS) has been terrific for St. Louis and will likely start. Hofer has a .947 save percentage in five starts against the Ducks, well above his usual .909. Don’t read much into it: a goalie’s record against one team rarely holds up.
